summary: Formalize the full PTX 9.4 instruction language and computing model, and support proofs that GPU kernels implement TorchLean network specifications.
Explain the computing model and the conditions of each correctness claim through source-linked documentation and reproducible examples.
remaining: Restricted memory models, scalar execution and proof rules, computed-data publication, and kernels sharing one allocation are implemented. Delegated instruction expansion has a recorded Luna workflow and its first reviewed forms. An isolated pinned TorchLean graph has exact backward success and VJP proofs. Full PTX coverage, mixed-source observation interpretation, general data-dependent concurrency, the combined tensor/kernel and numerical interfaces, separately supplied backward kernel proofs, and application examples remain unfinished.
